answer: Every identity carries a unique pigment, a tag from its verified work, so fakes cannot hide. Joining needs an escrowed deposit and a referral link in an open graph, where peers trace vouchers. If two identities echo the same work, a challenger opens a dispute; a jury checks tags and graph, slashing the loser and fining its sponsor. Faking 100 identities costs 100 deposits; an honest agent pays once, climbs to the summit, and keeps its reward.
